blind_reconstruction.text:
Let E be a complete finite-dimensional real inner-product space equipped with its Borel measurable structure. Let (A,mu) be any measurable probability space. Let V:E->R be C^2 and kappa be a nonnegative real with 1<=kappa, and assume that for every x,v in E,
  kappa^(-1)||v||^2 <= D^2 V(x)[v,v] <= ||v||^2.
Let eta,c,epsilon be real numbers with 0<eta<=c<1 and epsilon>0. Fix arbitrary functions q:E->E and N:E->N such that for every y in E,
  run(grad V,eta,epsilon,y,N(y)+1,y)=some(q(y),N(y)+1).
Here the finite interpreter run(g,eta,epsilon,y,fuel,x) returns none at zero fuel. With positive fuel it evaluates g(x) and sets next=y-eta g(x). It returns (x,1) when ||next-x||<=(1-eta)epsilon; otherwise it recurses from next with fuel decreased by one and adds one to a successful returned query count. Arithmetic is exact real arithmetic. Consequently N(y)+1 is the reported number of gradient tests, including the final successful test, for this successful run initialized at y.
For every measurable Y:A->E such that omega -> ||grad V(Y(omega))||^2 is integrable with respect to mu, the real-valued test count omega -> N(Y(omega))+1 is integrable with respect to mu, and
  integral_A (N(Y(omega))+1) dmu(omega)
    <= [2+(1+log((1-c)^(-1)))/(-log c)]
       [1+log(1+sqrt(integral_A ||grad V(Y(omega))||^2 dmu(omega))/epsilon)].
Natural counts in this formula are cast to the reals. Integrability is Bochner integrability. The logarithm is the real logarithm and the square root is the real square root. The conclusions concern the integrability and expected count of the stipulated successful exact-arithmetic interpreter; no existence of q or N, explicit pointwise complexity bound, output-error guarantee, sampling-kernel property, or convergence statement is asserted by this theorem.

import AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.SmoothedPicardHMC.ProximalExpectedWork

/-!
# Work of the same stopped proximal implementation under its realized input

arXiv:2609.06906v1 Algorithm D.2 and the Jensen step in Lemma D.4.
The center's squared-gradient moment remains explicit; this is not D.7 or D.8.
-/

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory InnerProductSpace
open scoped Topology NNReal

namespace AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.SmoothedPicardHMC.RealizedProximalWork

private theorem successful_query_unique {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] (g : E → E) (eta eps : ℝ) (y : E)
    {n m : ℕ} {x : E} {r s : E × ℕ}
    (hr : ApproximateProximalExecution.proximalQuery g eta eps y n x = some r)
    (hs : ApproximateProximalExecution.proximalQuery g eta eps y m x = some s) : r = s := by
  classical
  induction n generalizing m x r s with
  | zero => simp [ApproximateProximalExecution.proximalQuery] at hr
  | succ n ih =>
    cases m with
    | zero => simp [ApproximateProximalExecution.proximalQuery] at hs
    | succ m =>
      rw [ApproximateProximalExecution.proximalQuery] at hr hs
      split_ifs at hr hs with hstop
      · exact Option.some.inj (hr.symm.trans hs)
      · obtain ⟨r', hr', hrr⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.mp hr
        obtain ⟨s', hs', hss⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.mp hs
        have heq := ih hr' hs'
        simpa [← hrr, ← hss] using congrArg (fun z : E × ℕ => (z.1, z.2 + 1)) heq

/-- Expected work belongs to the actual successful stopped-query witness,
pulled back along the measurable realized center. No bound on an independent
existential count is substituted for the implementation's count. -/
theorem realized_proximal_expected_work
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [CompleteSpace E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {V : E → ℝ} {κ : ℝ≥0} (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E, (κ : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖v‖^2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ ‖v‖^2)
    {eta c eps : ℝ} (heta : 0 < eta) (hec : eta ≤ c) (hc : c < 1) (heps : 0 < eps)
    (q : E → E) (N : E → ℕ)
    (hrun : ∀ y, ApproximateProximalExecution.proximalQuery (gradient V) eta eps y
      (N y + 1) y = some (q y, N y + 1))
    (Y : α → E) (hY : Measurable Y)
    (hmoment : Integrable (fun ω => ‖gradient V (Y ω)‖^2) μ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => (N (Y ω) : ℝ) + 1) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, (N (Y ω) : ℝ) + 1 ∂μ) ≤
        (2 + (1 + Real.log ((1-c)⁻¹)) / (-Real.log c)) *
          (1 + Real.log (1 + Real.sqrt (∫ ω, ‖gradient V (Y ω)‖^2 ∂μ) / eps)) := by
  have hg : Continuous (gradient V) := by
    unfold gradient
    exact (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E).symm.continuous.comp
      (hV.continuous_fderiv (by norm_num))
  have hgs : Measurable (fun y => ‖gradient V y‖^2) := hg.measurable.norm.pow_const 2
  have hm : Integrable (fun y => ‖gradient V y‖^2) (μ.map Y) :=
    (integrable_map_measure hgs.aestronglyMeasurable hY.aemeasurable).mpr hmoment
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map Y) := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hY.aemeasurable
  obtain ⟨p, M, hp, hM, hout, hall, hcount, hbound⟩ :=
    ProximalExpectedWork.approximate_proximal_expected_work
      hκ hV hH heta hec hc heps (μ.map Y) hm
  have hNM : N = M := by
    funext y
    have h := successful_query_unique (gradient V) eta eps y (hrun y) (hall y).2.2
    exact Nat.add_right_cancel (congrArg Prod.snd h)
  subst N
  have hcnt : Measurable (fun y => (M y : ℝ) + 1) := by fun_prop
  refine ⟨(integrable_map_measure hcnt.aestronglyMeasurable hY.aemeasurable).mp hcount, ?_⟩
  simpa only [integral_map hY.aemeasurable hcnt.aestronglyMeasurable,
    integral_map hY.aemeasurable hgs.aestronglyMeasurable] using hbound

end AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.SmoothedPicardHMC.RealizedProximalWork

steps.title: Successful executions have identical outputs and query counts
steps.text: Induct on the first supplied fuel and inspect the other fuel. Zero fuel cannot succeed. At a positive-fuel successful residual test both runs return the same current point with count one. If that test fails, both recurse at the same next iterate, and the induction hypothesis equates the recursive outputs and counts. Both add the same final one.
steps.lean: private successful_query_unique; induction on fuel and Option.map_eq_some_iff.

steps.title: Use the actual input law
steps.text: Let nu be the pushforward of mu under Y. Measurability makes nu a probability measure. The C2 potential has continuous gradient; its squared norm is measurable. The pushforward integrability equivalence transfers the supplied actual-center gradient moment to nu.

steps.title: Identify the implementation with the expected-work witness
steps.text: The existing expected-work theorem gives a measurable successful count M and its integrable Jensen bound under nu. Compare that successful run at fuel M(y)+1 with the supplied run at N(y)+1, starting at the same y. Equality of the returned pairs implies N(y)+1=M(y)+1, hence N=M pointwise. This derives the needed measurability and integrability for the supplied N, without choosing a new implementation.
steps.lean: successful_query_unique, congrArg Prod.snd, Nat.add_right_cancel and funext.

steps.title: Pull the same count back to the realized center
steps.text: Apply the measurable pushforward identities to the identified count and gradient moment. Integrability of the count under nu pulls back to mu. Both Bochner integrals in the existing exact-constant bound become the corresponding actual-input expectations. No comparison of different probability laws or TV transfer is involved.

steps.lean: integrable_map_measure and integral_map transport the parent bound after pointwise count equality.
